description: Compares the runtime bytecode of two Ethereum contracts you name: the share of shared PUSH4 function selectors (Jaccard) and the cosine similarity of their opcode frequencies, combined into one 0 to 1 score with a SIMILAR, PARTIAL or DIFFERENT label. It compares two addresses only; it has no database of known scam or exploit templates, so it cannot say a contract is a known clone. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: agent_intel_bytecode_similarity_radar
title: Compares the runtime bytecode of two Ethereum contracts you
